description: This file defines data access classes for User and Note entities, providing methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting records in a database, using SQLAlchemy ORM and Flask-Werkzeug exceptions.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: Provides data access methods for User entities, such as creating and retrieving users.

classes.name: NoteRepository
classes.description: Provides data access methods for Note entities, including creation, listing with pagination, retrieval, updating, and deletion, scoped to specific users.

methods.name: User create_user(email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Creates a new user with the specified email and password, handling duplicate email conflicts.

methods.name: Optional[User] get_by_email(email: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user by email address.

methods.name: Note create_note(user: User, title: str, content: str)
methods.description: Creates a new note for a specific user with a title and content.

methods.name: Tuple[List[Note],dict] list_notes(user: User, page: int = 1, page_size: int = 20)
methods.description: Lists notes for a user with pagination and returns metadata.

methods.name: Note get_note(user: User, note_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note for a user by note ID.

methods.name: Note update_note(user: User, note_id: int, title: Optional[str] = None, content: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Updates the title and/or content of a user's note.

methods.name: None delete_note(user: User, note_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a user's note by note ID.
